newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: South Korea offers to sell arms to Philippines.
newsitem.headline: South Korea offers to sell arms to Philippines.

text.p: South Korea had offered to sell ammunition to Manila at a cut price as a token of gratitude for hosting North Korean defector Hwang Jang-yop in March, Philippine military officials said on Friday.

Officials from Seoul had discussed supplies of ammunition for 20mm guns, 2.75-inch rockets and 105mm Howitzers at a meeting in Manila on Thursday, said a senior military official who did not want to be named.
The South Korean delegation, comprising defence manufacturers and led by Lee Chong-nam, deputy minister for acquisition and technology, also offered to sell used F-5 fighter planes, he said.
The offer of discounted ammunition was "a token of gratitude for hosting Hwang," he said.
Hwang, the most senior North Korean ever to betray his homeland, spent a few weeks in the Philippines in March before going on to Seoul.
Hwang defected while on a visit to Beijing and came to the Philippines as part of a diplomatic deal that required him to go to a third country before going to South Korea.
